verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes for saved logins. The evidence shows it runs on iOS, Android, browser extensions and a desktop app, and one user relies on it for all 2FA, which suggests the same tokens are reachable on several devices. However, no evidence item states that items or TOTP secrets sync automatically and in real time across phone, tablet and computer. Older community comments saying there was no desktop app are superseded by the desktop-app docs, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic cross-device sync, specific mention of tablet support, and hands-on confirmation that tokens stay in sync across devices at once.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
Everything in your vaults is accessible whether you’re connected to the internet or not.
it's only available on iOS and Android as apps and as browser extensions elsewhere
Proton Pass is my default for all 2FA.
